newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Shell says 400 petrol stations may close.
newsitem.headline: Showa Shell says 400 petrol stations may close.

text.p: Showa Shell Sekiyu KK said on Thursday that intense price competition may force as many as 400 petrol stations in Japan selling Showa Shell brand gasoline to go out of business this year.
"Envisaging the worst scenario, about 400 petrol stations could close down this year," a Showa Shell spokesman said.
In 1996, about 200 petrol stations were forced out of business as a result of harsh market conditions.
About 100 new Showa Shell petrol stands opened during the year, bringing the total number to 7,013 by the end of 1996, the spokesman said.
Showa Shell plans to open about 100 new petrol stations this year, he said.
